name: pvlib-canonical
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is pvlib python, a library for simulating the performance of photovoltaic
energy systems: solar position, atmospheric and clear-sky models, irradiance transposition and
decomposition, angle-of-incidence and spectral losses, cell temperature, single-diode and other PV
performance models, inverters and transformers, trackers, shading and bifacial irradiance, snow and
soiling losses, the `PVSystem`/`Location`/`ModelChain` classes, and IV-curve parameter fitting.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the pvlib modelling core: the Python modules pvlib/__init__.py, albedo.py, atmosphere.py, clearsky.py, iam.py, inverter.py, irradiance.py, location.py, modelchain.py, pvarray.py, pvsystem.py, scaling.py, shading.py, singlediode.py, snow.py, soiling.py, solarposition.py, spa.py, temperature.py, tools.py, tracking.py and transformer.py, every module of pvlib/spectrum/, every module of pvlib/bifacial/ except pvlib/bifacial/pvfactors.py, and every module of pvlib/ivtools/ except pvlib/ivtools/sdm/cec.py, together with the user guide pages docs/sphinx/source/user_guide/getting_started/package_overview.rst and introtutorial.rst, docs/sphinx/source/user_guide/modeling_topics/iam.rst, clearsky.rst, spectrum.rst, singlediode.rst, modelchain.rst, temperature.rst, pvsystem.rst, timetimezones.rst and bifacial.rst, and docs/sphinx/source/user_guide/extras/nomenclature.rst and faq.rst, and the module, class and
